components.name: Control button
components.css: .ds-button{background:transparent;border:1px solid #657890;border-radius:5px;color:var(--ink,#eff5ff);font-family:"Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:17px;padding:10px 17px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,border-color .2s}.ds-button:hover{background:#1b2b42;border-color:var(--cyan,#62e7f4)}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--cyan,#62e7f4);outline-offset:5px}.ds-button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#183745;border-color:var(--cyan,#62e7f4);color:var(--cyan,#62e7f4)}

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Compact presenter navigation; opacity increases on hover or focus.
components.css: .ds-button{background:transparent;border:1px solid #657890;border-radius:5px;color:var(--ink,#eff5ff);font-family:"Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:17px;padding:10px 17px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,border-color .2s}.ds-button:hover{background:#1b2b42;border-color:var(--cyan,#62e7f4)}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--cyan,#62e7f4);outline-offset:5px}.ds-button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#183745;border-color:var(--cyan,#62e7f4);color:var(--cyan,#62e7f4)}.ds-nav{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;background:var(--bg,#070c17);color:var(--ink,#eff5ff);font-family:"Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:8px;opacity:.22;transition:opacity .2s}.ds-nav:hover,.ds-nav:focus-within{opacity:1}.ds-nav .ds-button{font-size:13px;padding:5px 10px}.ds-nav span{font-size:13px;min-width:58px;text-align:center}

narrative.overview:
The implemented presentation places physics diagrams, equations and interactive plots on a dark, spacious canvas. Its futuristic character comes from restrained luminous accents and smooth motion that explains pathways, population changes and staged conclusions.

This documents the current offline HTML presentation, not a general website theme. The audience is Senior Honours physics students; projected readability and the distinction between illustrative models, experimental data and commercial evidence shape the presentation.
keyCharacteristics: Dark canvas with bright, semantically consistent physics accents.
Large slide headlines and separate mathematical typography.
Inline charts, directed flow animation and presenter-controlled reveals.
Fixed aspect ratio with proportional viewport scaling.
dos: Do preserve the semantic physics accents and explicit series labels.
Do retain the centered 16:9 stage and large projected typography.
Do keep model assumptions, measured evidence and sources visibly identified.
Do use motion to explain pathways and allow presenter control.
donts: Don't rely on installed fonts rendering identically across operating systems.
Don't describe an illustrative animation or model curve as measured experimental data.
